definitions.explanation: The foot or leg on the left side of the body. As with {足|あし}, the word covers either the foot specifically or the whole leg, with context distinguishing the two.

examples.japanese: {左足|ひだりあし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
{左足|ひだりあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。

examples.english: He is good at kicking the ball with his left foot.

notes:
Like ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ itself, this word does not distinguish foot from leg; context decides. For an unambiguous reference to the leg above the ankle, use {左|ひだり}{脚|あし} (written with the leg-specific kanji ⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧) or pair with a body-part word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左足|ひだりあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧: to kick with the left foot
- {左足|ひだりあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧: to injure one's left foot/leg
- {左足|ひだりあし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{歩|ある}き{出|だ}す→歩き出す：30220_arukidasu⟧: to step off with the left foot

FORMS:
- ⟦{右足|みぎあし}→右足：28272_migiashi⟧: right foot/leg
- ⟦{両足|りょうあし}→両足：28926_ryouashi⟧: both feet/legs
- {片足|かたあし}: one foot/leg
